Package corewar.mars

Class Alu

java.lang.Object
corewar.mars.Alu
public class Alu extends Object
The ALU manages arithmetic calculations and logical comparisons. It ensures all memory addresses and values wrap around the circular RAM.

      pc - The current Program Counter.

    • goTo

      public int goTo(int pc, int val)
      Calculates the effective address by adding an offset to a base address, ensuring the result wraps around the circular memory.
      Parameters:
      pc - The base address (usually the current Program Counter).
      val - The offset to add (can be positive or negative).
      Returns:
      The normalized memory address within the bounds of the RAM.

    • add

      public void add(Instruction source, Instruction target, boolean isImmediate)
      Executes the ADD instruction.
      Parameters:
      source - The source instruction containing the values to add.
      target - The target instruction to be modified in RAM.
      isImmediate - If true (# mode), adds source A-field to target B-field. Otherwise, adds A to A and B to B.

    • sub

      public void sub(Instruction source, Instruction target, boolean isImmediate)
      Executes the SUB (Subtraction) instruction.
      Parameters:
      source - The source instruction containing the values to subtract.
      target - The target instruction to be modified in RAM.
      isImmediate - True if Mode A is immediate (#).

    • djn

      public boolean djn(Instruction target)
      Executes the DJN (Decrement and Jump if Not zero) logic.
      Parameters:
      target - The instruction whose B-field is to be decremented.
      Returns:
      true if the decremented value is non-zero, false otherwise.

    • cmp

      public boolean cmp(Instruction source, Instruction target, boolean isImmediate)
      Executes the CMP (Compare) instruction.
      Parameters:
      source - The source instruction to compare.
      target - The target instruction to compare against.
      isImmediate - True if Mode A is immediate (#).
      Returns:
      true if the compared values or instructions are equal.

    • slt

      public boolean slt(Instruction source, Instruction target, boolean isImmediate)
      Executes the SLT (Skip if Less Than) instruction.
      Parameters:
      source - The source instruction.
      target - The target instruction.
      isImmediate - True if Mode A is immediate (#).
      Returns:
      true if the source value is strictly less than the target value.
